kind: ephemeral local integrity projection; no persisted product record

admission.intent: journal intent equals the full canonical original plan digest
admission.coverage: exact canonical selected target set; no missing, extra or substituted targets
admission.state: every entry Durable with its required retained checksum
admission.snapshot: identity and metadata stay exactly journal-owned; original pre-capture plan cannot establish later captured ID

fresh_checks: admit retained original plan by exact digest and require held journal equality before traversal
require artifact parent and every derived artifact path to be directories
stream every published tree through existing no-follow checksum implementation
recheck held root, retained original plan and journal after traversal

custody.cooperating_layout_and_journal_exclusion: existing guards; returned view borrows held journal/layout lifetime
custody.verification: sequential observations, not atomic tree/set snapshot
custody.integration: maintain stable byte custody and authenticate retained capture/receipt and backend transfer evidence

retention: no record rewrite or journal transition on success or failure
ordinary reopen/resume reads retained progress without fresh byte verification
no refund or replenishment of original attempts
no reference release, prune or artifact deletion
non_authority: no current IC permission or authenticated transport
no captured snapshot identity or complete metadata/extent transfer proof
no application consistency or distributed checkpoint
no effect settlement, terminal proof, restart or dispatch permit
qualification: fresh native pure-policy, no-follow filesystem and public pending-attempt/restore-reference recovery tests; no actual IC backend
